Poveda Associate Professor, Department of E lectrical and Computer Engineering Associate Director, Center for Control, Systems, and Dynamics (CCSD) Affiliate, Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineerin g Office: EBU 1, Room 6407 Email: poveda@ucsd.edu Jorge I. Poveda is Associate Professor at the University of California, San Diego , in the ECE Department. He is the director of the Intelligence, Control, and Adaptation (INCEPTION) research laboratory, which develops theory and algorithms for the control, optimization, and operation of autonomous systems. Applications of interest typically incorporate adaptive feedback control loops, artificial intelligence, game theory, network systems, and hybrid dynamics . Examples include robotic systems, cyber-physical systems (energy, transportation, aerospace), sociotechnical systems, and bioengineering systems. Dr. Poveda's work has received different recognitions, including the 2023 Donald P. Eckman Award , the Young Investigator Awards from AFOSR and SHPE, the CRII and CAREER Awards from NSF, and the Engineering Early Career Faculty Development Award at UCSD (see Awards and Service for a complete list ). His research has been supported by DOE, NSF, AFOSR, DARPA, and several industry laboratories. Prospective Students, Postdocs, and Visiting Scholars: We are always looking for highly motivated students, postdocs, and visiting scholars with a strong interest in control, optimization, and learning systems. If interested, please reach out at poveda@ucsd.edu . For more information about admissions to UCSD, please click this link . sources.text: Faculty Profiles Back to Faculty Profiles Jorge Poveda Associate Professor, Electrical and Computer Engineering Poveda analyzes and designs high-performance and adaptive feedback control algorithms for complex non-smooth and hybrid dynamical systems. Poveda analyzes and designs high-performance and adaptive feedback control algorithms for complex non-smooth and hybrid dynamical systems. Such tools could enable safe, optimal and autonomous operations of cyber-physical systems such as the power grid, transportation systems, automated agricultural systems, mobile robots and social networks Capsule Bio: Jorge Poveda joined UC San Diego in 2022. Previously, he was on the faculty of the University of Colorado, Boulder. He earned his PhD from UC Santa Barbara. Update your profile Lab Website
